note: Payments made at the table that are not part of scoring a winning hand. Amounts are in bases (底); the app multiplies by the player's Base setting. `ruleId` links to the matching entry in Rules.json where one exists. Source: twmahjong.com (taiwan-16-hk) Chinese rule text.

payments.title: Dealer rolls 1-2-3
payments.when: The dealer's three dice come up 1, 2 and 3.

payments.title: Dealer rolls three of a kind
payments.when: The dealer's three dice all show the same number.

payments.title: All four season flowers
payments.when: A player collects all four of 春 夏 秋 冬. Paid straight away, whoever goes on to win.
payments.note: After taking this, the same player can't also collect for the plant set.

payments.title: All four plant flowers
payments.when: A player collects all four of 梅 蘭 菊 竹. Paid straight away, whoever goes on to win.
payments.note: The player may still go on to collect for the season set.

payments.title: All four players discard the same tile
payments.when: The same tile is discarded by all four players in a row.

payments.title: Called pung, then didn't take it
payments.when: A player calls "pung" on a discard but doesn't complete it.

payments.title: Concealed kong not shown at the end
payments.when: A player with a concealed kong doesn't turn it face up when the hand ends.
payments.note: The rule text doesn't say who receives it.

payments.title: Declared a win that wasn't one
payments.when: A player declares a win but the hand turns out not to be valid.
payments.note: A flat amount, not tied to the base. The rule text doesn't say who receives it.
